execSync('prettier --check a.css && echo --write');
execSync('prettier --check a.css || echo --write');
execSync('prettier --check a.css', { note: '--write' });
exec('prettier --check a.css', callback, '--write');
spawnSync('prettier', ['--check', 'a.css'], { note: '--write' });
execFileSync('prettier', ['--check', 'a.css'], () => '--write');
spawn('prettier', [], { note: '-w' });
execFile('prettier', ['--check', 'a.css'], callback, ['--write']);
